## 👋 Welcome!

My name is **Jiahao Tian**. I am an undergraduate student majoring in Statistics at the [School of Mathematical Sciences](http://www.math.zju.edu.cn), **Zhejiang University (ZJU)**. 

Prior to this, I was selected for the Chu Kochen Honors College (Physics). Driven by a profound passion for rigorous theoretical foundations, I transferred to Statistics to pursue **strict mathematical training**. My coursework and self-study heavily concentrate on advanced pure mathematics and measure-theoretic probability. Currently, my research focuses on high-dimensional statistical inference, distribution-free prediction, and their theoretical robustness.

---

## 🔍 Research Interests

* **Core:** High-Dimensional Statistical Inference, Conformal Prediction, Statistical Learning.
* **Extended:** Stochastic Analysis, Bayesian Inference, Quantitative Finance.

---

## 🛰️ [Research Experience](Projects/index.qmd)

### **Robustness of Multiple-Knockoff Aggregation Methods**
* **Advisor:** [Prof. Lijun Wang](https://hohoweiya.xyz/), Zhejiang University. *(Sept. 2025 – Present)*
* Identified catastrophic power collapse ($\text{Power} \to 0$) in e-value, AKO, and voting-based aggregation under Cauchy distribution, characterizing the "zero-dilution effect" where signal sparsity propagates across multiple runs. Proved a multiplicity-based threshold inflation theorem using Extreme Value Theory (EVT) and Hoeffding's inequality, showing that null multiplicity $(p-k \gg k)$ forces thresholds to $\mathcal{O}(np)$. Evaluated robust statistics (LAD-Lasso, Cauchy Regression, Log-Squashing Lasso) to stabilize heavy tails via symmetric log-transforms.
* *Status: First-author manuscript in preparation.*

### **Uncertainty Quantification via Conformal Prediction**
* **Advisor:** [Prof. Guanhua Chen](https://sites.google.com/view/gchenwisc/), UW–Madison. *(Mar. 2026 – Present)*
* Established a Fourier analytic framework to prove the robustness of Characteristic Function Distance (CFD) kernels under extreme covariate shift, demonstrating the stability of Laplace and Energy kernels via polynomial frequency penalization over Gaussian geometry. Integrated CFD weighting into UACQR and Split CP with Cholesky decomposition protection, successfully suppressing infinite interval rates ($5.8\% \to 2.0\%$) and identifying the "dimensionality paradox" and variance-bias trade-off in high-dimensional QRF.
* *Status: First-author manuscript in preparation.*
